name: x-search
description: Search X (Twitter) posts and people for Mia Bot with xAI's X Search, using your own xAI API key. Keyword and meaning-based search, filters by account and date, and links to every post quoted. You pay xAI directly for what you use (about $0.10 to $0.25 per search); Mia Bot charges nothing. Read-only: it cannot post.
